item.title: Context Is the Bottleneck: Building a Knowledge Assistant for a Legacy Codebase
item.author: mattnorberg4@gmail.com (Matthew Norberg)
item.description: How a keynote about context led me to build a Databricks app that gives our coding assistant full knowledge of a legacy codebase we’re reverse-engineering.
